# Fixed-source PDF to PPTX subset

Source: GenOffice `f8c17004fb730df11f0f743164ffd8b4281bb38c`, `packages/pdf2docx/src`. Apache-2.0 LICENSE/NOTICE accompany this subset. `SOURCE-SHA256.json` records every original path/hash and the copied local hash.

The 41-file static import closure begins at `rebuild-pptx/index.ts`: shared PDFium extraction, geometry/layout analysis, IR, font substitution and PPTX reconstruction. It does not import the package-wide index, DOCX or XLSX rebuilders, desktop filesystem adapters, or `ocr-vision.ts`.

Three local adaptations change only `../../../pptx-engine/src/` to the already vendored `slides_engine/packages/pptx-engine/src/` path in `rebuild-pptx/{rebuild,table,text}.ts`. Existing `vendor/font-metrics` satisfies the original sibling import. `bidi-js` supplies bidi layout. The PDF build explicitly pins JSZip/fast-xml-parser and local zip-gate/agent-core dependencies so the shared PPTX source also bundles without sibling node_modules; PDFium/WASM and the slide engine already exist.

The source `ocr.ts` defines shared types and an optional engine dispatcher. The bridge supplies no OCR engine, imports no platform OCR implementation and starts no OCR process/service. Scan-only pages retain the original upstream image fallback and explicit page outcomes/warnings. No claim of fully editable scanned text or complete layout fidelity is made.

The local bridge binds source SHA, file/page/pixel budgets and nonprotected input. It preserves the actual generated bytes and warnings when post-generation structure review fails. HTTP authorization, immutable derived revision registration, publication and runtime packaging remain owned by the existing native editor integration.


## DOCX and XLSX extension (2026-11-11)

The fixed-ref closure includes the original DOCX rebuild and XLSX rebuild.
The DOCX import is redirected to the existing slides_engine/packages/docx-engine;
no content reconstruction algorithm is rewritten. XLSX uses the original cell
rebuild, with a local bridge adaptation embedding scanned/degraded page renders
through the existing xlsx-engine applyStaticImage writer. Normal-page floating
images/decor remain unsupported and produce an explicit warning. OCR is never
supplied. SOURCE-SHA256.json records every original/local hash separately.


## PPTX cell-flow adaptation (2026-11-11)

Complex-fixture LibreOffice rendering exposed false wrapping: the upstream
adapter treated all unused trailing cell space as a right inset, leaving only
the tight PDF glyph-ink width. The local table adapter now reuses upstream
cell horizontal-alignment inference and preserves the anchor-side measured
inset, while limiting the opposite padding to the smaller measured inset.
Column widths, rows, text runs, writer and wrapping mechanism are unchanged.
Original source hash remains recorded; the changed local hash and adaptation
are explicit in SOURCE-SHA256.json. Full visual fidelity is not implied.


## PDFium built-in output font aliases (2026-11-11)

PDFium extracts built-in Helvetica, Times and Courier substitutes as Chrom Sans
OTF, Chrom Serif OTF and Chrom Fixed OTF. The local font map recognizes these
three known names through its existing metric-compatible candidate lists. An
installed source family still wins; unknown/unavailable families stay unchanged.
This avoids leaving basic font-class selection to Office name guessing, but does
not embed original PDF fonts or imply exact font/layout fidelity. The original
source hash and the adapted local hash remain separately recorded.


## XLSX source-picture coordinates (2026-11-11)

Cell-data quarter-turn recovery rotates image boxes to recover upright cells,
but encoded image pixels stay in displayed-page orientation. A narrow local
adaptation records the already chosen recovery quarter turn in ExtractedPage,
propagates it to IrPage and exports the existing rotateToDisplay helper. The
bridge uses its inverse only for source-picture reference-area coordinates.
Original extraction, reading-order and worksheet layout algorithms are unchanged.
SOURCE-SHA256.json records original and changed local hashes separately.


## PPTX measured baseline leading (2026-11-11)

The complex fixture has 16pt source baseline steps in both eight-line columns.
The original glyph-ink block height divided by line count produced 14.97pt and
15.21pt, varying by the outer glyph extents rather than the authored baseline
steps. The local paragraph adapter now reuses existing Line.baseline values
and the existing median helper for positive finite adjacent gaps. The original
ink-height fallback remains for one line or unavailable baseline metrics; page
scaling, hard breaks, fonts and textbox positioning are unchanged. Exact source
and adapted local hashes remain separately recorded. Absolute text placement
and arbitrary variable-leading paragraphs are not certified by this change.

2026-11-11 XLSX table width adaptation: emitTable assigns each source grid-column width to its covered sheet-slot intervals instead of claiming the whole width in the first slot and retaining default widths in intervening merged columns. Existing maximum claims, continuation run bounds, merges and cell content remain. Tiny indistinguishable grid columns keep the previous fallback; minimum two-character widths, default font/MDW conversion, prose flow and image reference layout remain limitations. This does not establish physical print-width or source-page fidelity.

2026-11-11：rebuild-pptx/text.ts 与 rebuild.ts 增加安全来源span.href到现有PPTX TextRun/关系API的限定适配，保留HTTP/HTTPS/mailto和有效页内跳转、独立click范围及原颜色/下划线。共享PPTX writer未修改；首行基线及完整版式仍未通过保真。来源blob SHA保持固定，本地hash单列。

2026-11-11 DOCX exact text-fill adaptation: the PDF IR already records RGB highlights. `vendor/pdf2docx/src/rebuild/index.ts` (converter-relative `src/rebuild/index.ts`) now retains exact non-palette six-digit RGB as the existing shared writer Run.shading and compares shading when merging runs. Exact named palette entries keep named highlight output; white remains unshaded. No shared DOCX writer, layout, font, or dependency change. Notes still lack a shading carrier; complete PDF/DOCX fidelity is not certified. Fixed source hashes remain unchanged, local hashes recorded separately.
